shortDescription: NTA UGC NET June 2026 re-exam admit card and exam-city updates are available. Download the hall ticket from the official NTA portal.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has updated the UGC NET June 2026 re-examination links. Candidates can download the re-exam admit card and check the revised exam-city details from the official examination portal.

The latest admit-card notice was issued on 04 September 2026. Download the hall ticket only from the official login, verify the centre and reporting time, and carry a printed copy with a valid photo ID.

How to download

  1. Open the official NTA admit-card login
  2. Enter the application details
  3. Download and print the admit card
  4. Check the re-exam centre and shift instructions
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I verify NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam Notice 2026?
faqs.answer: Use the official website: https://ugcnet.nta.ac.in. This page only points you there.

faqs.question: Are the dates on this page final?
faqs.answer: No. Treat every date as a prompt to re-check the latest PDF or login dashboard on the official portal.

faqs.question: What should I keep ready?
faqs.answer: Registration number, password or date of birth, photo ID and printed admit card
